attention_null: A relation/member bias constant inside a per-relation neighborhood softmax cancels exactly. A nonconstant edge score adapter can change weights, but ordinary native attention already implements that operation.
criterion: On one declared full finite context with centered-logit metric, let Jfast be the complete current private Jacobian and Jgraph the additional block derivative. New first-order directions require rank([Jfast,Jgraph])>rank(Jfast), equivalently (I−Pi_fast)Jgraph!=0. No ranks/projectors/tensors were evaluated.
criterion_limit: Metric/context and downstream nonlinearities matter. A nonzero graph derivative, differing coefficient vector, noncommuting abstract operators or one-item error derivative does not certify the actual stacked-output condition. It is standard tangent-space analysis, not a new learning principle.
defensible_remaining_gap: Empirical usefulness and sharing bias of a specified compact private graph correction beyond equal-information competent single and independent controls; this is already-known component utility, not novelty clearance.
filter_bank_absorption: G_m(P)H=sum_k a_mk T_k(P)H can be implemented by coefficient mixing inside a head on the full same bank. This exact forward relocation preserves nonlinear processing/pooling when the head retains the same operations. Mean raw logits admit additional linear folding; probability averaging cannot be silently folded as mean logits.
formal_error_repair_site: H_m_plus=sigma((A H_m)W + q_m(C H_m)U + H_m V). W,U,V shared; q_m private scalar. The contrast is inserted before lossy relation aggregation/nonlinear decoding; all members remain in the declared serving pool. This is formal known-operator tying, not source, numeric recipe or proposed grid.
gauge_boundary: Valid invertible R/S coordinate gauges preserve the complete output Jacobian range. A graph block can add directions only when its actual output derivative lies outside the old range.
prior_equivalence: The operation is a two-relation operator bank with restricted maps and private adapters, covered by R-GCN/HGT/FiLM-type ancestry. A capable relation-bank single and same-operation independent ensemble can express it. It is not a new propagation, relation-conditioning or graph-diversity principle.
relation_contrast: For fixed declared relation operators A=P1+P2 and C=P1−P2, [C,A]=2[P1,P2]. If this commutator is nonzero,C is not any scalar polynomial p(A) as an operator. For a particular H,CH can nevertheless lie in the same data-response span or downstream nullspace.
repair_failure_conditions: Relations have no independently available task meaning or encode prohibited labels.
Shared stem already discarded the needed feature, or downstream decoder killsCH.
Capable common encoder already preserves all needed basis/relations.
Same signed correction cannot suit regions with opposite useful relation patterns.
Members learn identical or nuisance contrasts, or all-member pooling dilutes a useful member.
Extra capacity/step scale/selection work explains the gain.
specific_hypothesis: If two available semantic relations carry differently useful evidence and common aggregation hides that distinction, TRAIN gradients can learn a signed contrast that suppresses one relation while retaining another. It may repair actual errors that a single collapsed-operator representation cannot. No such failure is established in the native Amazon/NCNC model.
